cards.target: Han tänder lampan.
cards.english: He turns on the lamp.

cards.target: Hon har precis lämnat.
cards.english: She has just left.

cards.target: Vi sätter på musiken.
cards.english: We turn on the music.

cards.target: Vi räknar ut svaret.
cards.english: We figure out the answer.

cards.target: Vi sätter igång projektet.
cards.english: We start up the project.

cards.target: Hon tar upp frågan.
cards.english: She brings up the question.

cards.target: Jag fyller i formuläret.
cards.english: I fill in the form.

cards.target: Vi plockar upp skräpet.
cards.english: We pick up the trash.

cards.target: Vi delar ut priserna.
cards.english: We hand out the prizes.

cards.target: Först då förstod jag.
cards.english: Only then did I understand.

cards.target: Han tar av sig skorna.
cards.english: He takes off his shoes.

cards.target: Jag bryter ihop av stress.
cards.english: I break down from stress.

cards.target: Han hittar på en ursäkt.
cards.english: He makes up an excuse.

cards.target: Vi tar oss an uppgiften.
cards.english: We take on the task.

cards.target: Jag håller ut till slutet.
cards.english: I persevere to the end.

cards.target: Vi tar oss igenom vintern.
cards.english: We get through the winter.

cards.target: Jag tar på mig jackan.
cards.english: I put on my jacket.

cards.target: Vi har hittills klarat oss.
cards.english: We have managed so far.

cards.target: Dig vill jag prata med.
cards.english: You I want to talk to.

cards.target: Mer tid hade vi behövt.
cards.english: More time we would have needed.

cards.target: Vi ger inte upp ibland här.
cards.english: We don't give up sometimes here.

cards.target: Gå kan jag, men inte springa.
cards.english: Walk I can, but not run.

cards.target: Vi går vidare till nästa punkt.
cards.english: We move on to the next point.

cards.target: Ut sprang katten på morgonen snart.
cards.english: Out ran the cat in the morning soon.

cards.target: Han drar sig tillbaka förra veckan också.
cards.english: He withdrew last week too.

cards.target: Vem som än frågar, säg inget verkligen.
cards.english: No matter who asks, say nothing.

cards.target: Inte förrän nästa vecka kan jag svara.
cards.english: Not until next week can I answer.

cards.target: Så vackert det var på morgonen redan!
cards.english: It was so beautiful in the morning!

cards.target: Inte ens en gång tänkte han på det.
cards.english: Not even once did he think about it.

cards.target: Jag glömde att stänga av spisen innan vi gick ut.
cards.english: I forgot to turn off the stove before we went out.

cards.target: Låt oss gå ut och fira att vi äntligen ses igen!
cards.english: Let us go out and celebrate seeing each other again!

cards.target: Hon plockar undan efter festen.
cards.english: She tidies up after the party.

cards.target: Hon skiljer sig från mängden.
cards.english: She stands out from the crowd.

cards.target: Hon biter ihop och kämpar.
cards.english: She grits her teeth and fights.

cards.target: Allt som oftast regnar det.
cards.english: More often than not it rains.

cards.target: Långsamt vaknade staden till liv.
cards.english: Slowly the city awoke to life.

cards.target: Snön gnisslade under hans stövlar.
cards.english: The snow crunched under his boots.

cards.target: Därav kan man dra slutsatsen.
cards.english: From this one can draw the conclusion.

cards.target: Hon slår sig ner i soffan.
cards.english: She sits down on the sofa.

cards.target: Vi ger oss av på resa.
cards.english: We set off on a trip.

cards.target: Mig veterligen finns det inget bevis.
cards.english: To my knowledge there's no evidence.

cards.target: Emedan solen sken var alla glada.
cards.english: As the sun shone, everyone was happy.

cards.target: Hon ser till att allt är klart.
cards.english: She makes sure everything is ready.

cards.target: Hon springer om honom under veckan också.
cards.english: She overtakes him during the week too.

cards.target: Det var med stor förvåning jag hörde.
cards.english: It was with great surprise I heard.

cards.target: Så trött var han att han somnade.
cards.english: So tired was he that he fell asleep.

cards.target: Härav följer att vi måste agera nu.
cards.english: From this it follows that we must act now.

cards.target: Det var inte alls vad jag förväntade mig.
cards.english: It was not at all what I expected.

cards.target: Den gamla mannens ögon berättade mer än ord.
cards.english: The old man's eyes told more than words.

cards.target: Jag sätter mig in i ämnet till slut.
cards.english: I familiarize myself with the subject in the end.

cards.target: Spotify grundades i Stockholm just nu under sommaren.
cards.english: Spotify was founded in Stockholm one summer.

cards.target: Oaktat problemen slutfördes projektet på morgonen till slut.
cards.english: Despite the problems, the project was eventually completed.

cards.target: Flamingon står på ett ben vid den grunda sjön.
cards.english: The flamingo stands on one leg by the shallow lake.

cards.target: Hur svårt det än är ger jag inte upp.
cards.english: No matter how hard it is, I won't give up.

cards.target: Så fort jag kom hem från jobbet somnade jag direkt.
cards.english: As soon as I came home from work I fell asleep immediately.

cards.target: Inte bara regnade det kraftigt utan det haglade också den dagen.
cards.english: Not only did it rain heavily but it also hailed that day.

cards.target: Hon dyker upp oväntat vid dörren med blommor och en flaska vin.
cards.english: She shows up unexpectedly at the door with flowers and a bottle of wine.

cards.target: In kom barnen från regnet, skrattande och drypande våta över hela golvet.
cards.english: In came the children from the rain, laughing and dripping wet all over the floor.

cards.target: Nästa år slår vi ihop avdelningarna för att spara kostnader och jobba effektivare.
cards.english: Next year we will merge the departments to save costs and work more efficiently.

cards.target: Ju mer du övar på att prata svenska, desto mer självsäker kommer du att bli.
cards.english: The more you practise speaking Swedish, the more confident you will become.

existing_tips: Verb topicalization: placing the infinitive first for emphasis.
'Tillbaka' (back) as a particle: 'komma tillbaka' (come back), 'ge tillbaka' (give back).
